youtube.title: Someone Poisoned Tylenol and Was Never Caught | The 1982 Tylenol Murders
youtube.description:
In the fall of 1982, seven people in the Chicago area died after taking Extra-Strength Tylenol capsules laced with cyanide. The youngest was 12. James Lewis sent Johnson & Johnson a letter demanding $1 million to stop the killings; he was convicted of attempted extortion but never charged with the murders, and died in 2023. The case led to tamper-evident packaging and remains open.

📂 Case File #018: The Tylenol Murders

Sources: NBC News and CBS Chicago (July 2023).
